fidelity_constructs.vol: correlation of the stress index with realised rolling volatility (the conventional validation criterion; identical to the volatility trigger's own output, so that tool scores 1.00 by construction)
fidelity_constructs.moments: mean correlation of the stress index with three realised moments: rolling volatility, rolling absolute return and rolling mean pairwise flow correlation (no candidate is scored against its own output)

static_circuit_breaker.basis: rolling return limit halting the whole market

dynamic_throttle.basis: sentinel informed targeted throttle of flagged agents

kill_switch.basis: RTS 6 Article 12 kill functionality applied to sentinel flagged agents: immediate cancellation for a dwell period

luld_style_band.basis: Limit Up-Limit Down Plan: 5% band around a five minute reference price, 15 second limit state, five minute pause; mapped to steps

market_wide_breaker.basis: Market wide circuit breaker levels of 7%, 13% and 20% decline from the reference close: 15 minute halts at levels one and two, halt for the day at level three; mapped to steps

venue_volatility_halt.basis: MiFID II Article 48(5) and the ESMA guidelines on circuit breaker calibration: dynamic collar on the last price and static collar on a reference price; a breach triggers a volatility interruption of set length; parameters are illustrative

responsive_ladder.basis: Ayres and Braithwaite 1992 enforcement pyramid: escalate from a targeted throttle to kill functionality to a market wide halt only when the lower rung fails; step down on recovery

family_notes.empirical: held out: shock and volatility taken from an observed dataset brought through quarantine
family_notes.evader: dominant vendor rotates three cohorts to defeat correlation based sentinels
family_notes.herd_high: 40% of agents on one vendor, signal correlation 0.90
family_notes.herd_low: 20% on one vendor, correlation 0.65 (near the label threshold)
family_notes.holdout_herd: held out: 150 agents, three vendors, later shock, higher impact
family_notes.holdout_quiet: held out: 150 agents, three vendors, no shock
family_notes.ignition: colluding cluster of 8% ignites momentum with a sell burst across the shock, then reverses; a 20% vendor at correlation 0.65 follows
family_notes.liquidity_withdrawal: liquidity providers step away after the shock, the IMF (2024) channel of AI market makers withdrawing in stress
family_notes.misinformation: the shock is disinformation retracted after 20 steps (FSB 2024 and IOSCO 2025 deepfake and disinformation channel); the herd amplifies a false move
family_notes.mixed: two vendors of 25% each, correlations 0.80 and 0.20
family_notes.persona_llm: 35% of agents trade from one distilled LLM persona table (momentum follower); the foundation model monoculture channel
family_notes.quiet: no shock; vendor correlation below the destabilising threshold
family_notes.rl_emergent: 48 independently trained RL traders; herding is learned, not imposed
family_notes.vendor_fault: a faulty third party model: for 25 steps every agent on the 35% vendor receives the same erroneous sell signal (Bank of England 2026 kill switch case; IOSCO 2026 contingency planning)
